title: kv-tier-management
summary: Manage runtime KV cache tiers (GPU → CPU RAM → local disk) for LLM serving: decide when KV is stored, retained, prefetched, or evicted; size the concurrency-versus-RAM-pressure trade-off with an explicit in-flight admission dial; order RAM-release levers; and measure with token-level L1/L2 hit rates and prefetch-pressure counters. Use when configuring KV offload for a serving stack. Covers runtime KV offload only — model startup/loading, checkpoint save/restore, and block-device profiling are separate concerns (see weight-loading-optimization).
